motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: stick
motion.purpose: Sticker drops from -26px, scale 1.08, +7deg, shadow lifted to rest, on page entry.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Speech bubble scales from 0.6 out of its tail corner, after the sticker.

motion.name: thump
motion.purpose: Stamp lands from scale 1.35 after the stickers (delay 600ms).

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay step between stickers on one page.

components.name: Slot
components.description: Dashed, numbered place for a sticker still to come; caption below.
components.css: .ds-slotbg{background:#855cd6;padding:24px;color:#fff;font-family:"Lexend Variable",sans-serif}.ds-slotwrap{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:104px}.ds-slot{display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:104px;border:4px dashed color-mix(in srgb,#fff 55%,transparent);border-radius:22px;background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 18%,transparent);box-sizing:border-box}.ds-slot span{font-family:"Lilita One",sans-serif;font-size:34px;color:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 75%,transparent)}.ds-cap{font-size:20px;font-weight:600}.ds-slot:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 26%,transparent)}

components.name: Sticker
components.description: Die-cut picture: white edge dilated from its own alpha, tilted, ink-tinted soft shadow; sticks on entry.
components.css: .ds-stickbg{background:#cf63cf;padding:32px;display:inline-block}.ds-sticker{transform:rotate(-6deg);transform-origin:50% 60%;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgb(27 19 64 / 0.28));animation:ds-stick 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}@keyframes ds-stick{from{transform:translateY(-26px) scale(1.08) rotate(1deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 30px rgb(27 19 64 / 0.2))}to{transform:rotate(-6deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgb(27 19 64 / 0.28))}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sticker{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
The day is a sticker album the kid fills at their own pace. Each slide is one printed album page, full-bleed in a single Scratch block colour with a faint printed dot raster. Each idea is one die-cut Scratch sticker; ideas still to come are dashed, numbered empty slots. Done is a sticker, still to come is a slot: state is shown as a physical mark, never as a progress bar or a list.

Pages are sparse: one heading, at most a few short lines, one to three stickers. Rank comes from size, weight and colour, not from boxes, rules or bullets. The world refuses the white school slide with a purple title bar and bullet points.
keyCharacteristics: One Scratch block colour per page, full bleed, 22px dot raster.
Die-cut white edge that follows each sprite's own outline, soft lifted shadow, slight tilt.
Dashed rounded slots in a light tint for what is still to come.
Lilita One for display, Lexend for text; three sizes.
One entry gesture: the sticker "sticks" when the page opens.

rules.name: The One Block Colour Rule
rules.body: A page has exactly one ground, chosen from the Scratch block colours. No gradients, no second ground colour, no white slides.

rules.name: The Ink Follows The Ground Rule
rules.body: Looks Purple takes white ink; every lighter ground (motion, events, operators, myblocks, sound) takes `ink: dark`. All chrome (dot raster, slot outlines, slot numbers, page badge) derives from the current ink, never from a hard-coded colour.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: New content uses display, text or print, nothing else. Rank within a size comes from weight and colour. (The Haiku's 62px poem is the only exception and is an open decision.)

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always tinted with the album ink (`rgb(27 19 64 / …)`), never neutral black.

dos: Do give every page exactly one Scratch block-colour ground and set `ink: dark` on every ground except looks.
Do show what is still to come as a dashed numbered slot and what is there as a sticker in it.
Do use only the display, text and print sizes for new content.
Do tilt every sticker slightly and let it stick on entry with the shared easing.
Do use Scratch library sprites or own drawings in Scratch clipart style, credited in the presenter notes.
donts: Don't use white slides, title bars or bullet lists.
Don't put a second ground colour, gradient or neutral-black shadow on a page.
Don't use dashed borders for anything but slots.
Don't add looping or fast motion beyond the one entry gesture per element; the only loop is the agent video.
